notes:
• Awards & decisions: legal authorities now carry case name, case number, decision type, tribunal, rules, seat, treaty, outcome and source — “Paste Reference” fills them from a Jus Mundi reference line, “Detect from Text” reads the cover page, and citations follow the Jus Mundi style (Exhibit CL-7, Muhammet Çap & Sehil v. Turkmenistan, ICSID Case No. ARB/12/6, Award, 4 May 2021, ¶ 312). New template under Settings ▸ Citation.
• Bugfix run — 56 fixes, including: rotated scans came out upside down in bundles; inline citations (German/Swiss default) could not be updated or managed; citing into an existing footnote lost the earlier citation on Update; restoring a backup could delete the chosen backup; deleting a duplicate removed the shared file; numbering and the Word data file used the filtered list instead of the whole matter; the inspector could erase a freshly assigned number; Convert to Plain Text flattened every field in the document; the metadata cleaner could drop text from commented .docx files; e-signing crashed on non-Latin characters in the reason; provider errors were labelled “DeepL”; German templates left a stray “vom” for undated exhibits; Settings defaults for numbering and party side now apply.
